subject: Billing contact swap + temporary signed PDF while portal enrolls
messages:
From: Alex Novak <ap@acme-retail.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap-team@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New billing contact for Acme + delivery preference

Hi Kimberly,

Quick one from our AP side as we're finishing vendor setup for Redwood. We need to confirm: who will be the invoice originator (name/email) on the invoice PDF, and whether Redwood can push invoices into our portal via SFTP/API or should we expect emailed PDFs to ap@acme-retail.com. Also any VAT tagging required on the invoice for US registrations?

If you can let us know the options and a contact for billing (or a temporary email we should expect), that would help speed things up.

Thanks,
Alex Novak
Senior AP Analyst
Acme Retail
ap@acme-retail.com

---
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Alex Novak <ap@acme-retail.com>
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New billing contact for Acme + delivery preference

Alex — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: we support both.

Options we can offer today:
- Portal push (recommended for scale): SFTP or secure API drop. We can provision a collector identity and deliver UBL/XML or PDF bundles.
- Email copy (backup): single PDF to your ap@acme-retail.com address; we can cc an alternate billing contact.
- Hybrid during onboarding: temporary signed PDF copies while you complete portal enrollment.

VAT: for US-registered entities there’s no EU-style VAT tagging required, but we can include tax ID fields and a VAT tag for any EU entities if needed.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you want portal enrollment, please complete the attached portal-enroll-form.pdf and return — we’ll initiate provisioning (turnaround ~5 business days).
2) For immediate invoices we can send signed-temp-invoice.pdf to ap@acme-retail.com through end of month.
3) Confirm the invoice originator name you prefer to appear on the PDF (bill@redwood.ai or accounts@redwood.ai).

If helpful, Connor (cc'd) can run through the SFTP/API details — Connor, can you take point if they pick portal?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: portal-enroll-form.pdf (fillable form, 2 pages)

Cc: AP Team <ap-team@acme-retail.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700

Kimberly — thank you.

We'd like to do the hybrid approach: please send the immediate invoices as signed PDFs to ap@acme-retail.com and we'll fill out the portal form in parallel. For the invoice originator, please use bill@redwood.ai.

One other ask: our AP team requires PO number to be present in the invoice metadata and a remittance instruction block. Can you confirm the XML sample contains fields for PO/Remit? You attached sample-invoice-xml.xml in the onboarding we saw earlier — can you resend an example with PO and remit element names so our system maps them correctly?

Appreciate it — we'll get the portal form back by end of this week.

Alex

- Invoice originator will be bill@redwood.ai as requested.

1) signed-temp-invoice.pdf (PDF copy)
2) sample-invoice-xml.xml (mapping example)
3) portal-enroll-form.pdf (resend, if needed)

If you want, we can arrange a 20-minute mapping call to confirm PO/remit fields — open times tomorrow 10–11am or 2–3pm PT.

Thanks,
